blocks.title: Maintenance
blocks.text: Maintenance is the final phase of the SDLC: ongoing maintenance and updates make sure the software continues to function correctly and adapts to changes in user needs or technology.
Maintenance is like taking care of a plant: you need to water it regularly and deal with any problems to keep it healthy and growing.
